name: oneai-cli
description: Cross-platform launcher for the OneAI engine (oneai-cli TUI + subcommands, `oneai web` one-command webUI). Postinstall fetches the platform binary from GitHub Releases; the bin forwards argv + stdio with zero business logic. The web dist is bundled here (built at publish via prepublishOnly). Falls back to `oneai` on PATH if no binary is downloaded (e.g. a dev who `cargo install`-ed).
